customer_message: @AppleSupport touch screen not working properly after drop
resolution_text: If your display is unresponsive, perform a force restart by pressing Volume Up, Volume Down, then holding Side button until the Apple logo appears. Visit support.apple.com/repair if physical damage occurred.

customer_message: @apple support hey i have a few problem with my software with my apple iphone 12
resolution_text: We'd be glad to help with your iPhone 12! Could you share what iOS version you're on and describe what happens when the software issue occurs?

customer_message: I can't download APK in my iphone x
resolution_text: Thanks for reaching out to @AppleSupport! iOS devices only support applications downloaded directly from the official Apple App Store and do not support Android APK installation packages.
